title: Jamaican Curry Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with chicken, nutty spices, and a hint of Jamaican flair.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Coat the chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
